# Dual of the code generated by a matrix

**Dual of the code generated by a matrix.** Let $G$ be a matrix over a field $F$ with finitely
many rows and finitely many columns. Then the dual of the code generated by $G$ (the span of its
rows) is the code with parity-check matrix $G$ (the words $x$ with $Gx = 0$).
